quantity: libraries whose selected read-length window is identical on both routes
calculation: Per route take the selected (in_phase1) read lengths per sample; count the samples whose (min, max) window matches.

quantity: (library, read length) cells selected by either route
calculation: Size of the union of selected (sample, read_length) cells over both routes.

quantity: cells selected by one route only
calculation: Cells in the union but not the intersection, split by which route selected them.

quantity: selected cells whose P-site offset differs between routes
calculation: Over cells selected by BOTH routes, count those whose psite_offset differs.

quantity: cells selected by both routes
calculation: Size of the intersection of selected (sample, read_length) cells.

quantity: median genome-minus-transcriptome whole-CDS frame-0 difference
calculation: Join the two routes on (sample, read_length); median of genome pct_frame0 minus transcriptome pct_frame0.

quantity: mean absolute frame-0 difference
calculation: Mean of the absolute difference, same join.

quantity: maximum absolute frame-0 difference
calculation: Maximum of the absolute difference, and the (sample, read_length) carrying it.

quantity: median Spearman rho, P-site coverage
calculation: Median of spearman_all over the 24 rows, one per cell line.

quantity: median Pearson r, P-site coverage
calculation: Median of pearson_all over the 24 rows.

quantity: median Spearman rho, footprint coverage
calculation: Median of spearman_all over the 24 rows.

quantity: median Pearson r, footprint coverage
calculation: Median of pearson_all over the 24 rows.

quantity: transcripts passing the CPM gate (> 1 CPM in all four matrices in >= 12 of 24 lines)
calculation: Number of data rows of per_gene_delta.tsv; the gate is applied by code/te_route/normalization.R, which asserts the count.

quantity: size-factor estimation set (non-zero in all four matrices and all lines)
calculation: Rows non-zero everywhere after the gate; asserted by code/te_route/normalization.R.

quantity: median per-cell-line route agreement on log2 TE
calculation: Median over the 24 rows of each column.

quantity: median delta TE (genome minus transcriptome, log2) and its IQR
calculation: Median and 25th/75th percentiles of dte_mean over the 11,589 rows.

quantity: transcripts with lower / higher TE under genome alignment
calculation: Count of dte_mean < 0 and dte_mean > 0.

quantity: transcripts with padj < 0.05 and |delta TE| > 1
calculation: Benjamini-Hochberg padj < 0.05 and |dte_mean| > 1, split by sign.

quantity: read-ID union per gene (GSM2100602) and its largest segment
value: COMT 1,295 (shared unique 1,084); GAPDH 4,360 (shared multi, pseudogene tie 2,207); LRRFIP1 1,525 (genome-only unique on an omitted exon 755)
calculation: n_union per gene and the n_reads of the named segment; every segment count is asserted by code/alignment_fate/build_gene_partition_data.py.

quantity: LRRFIP1 locus, selected and alternative isoform, exonic sequence absent from the selected reference
calculation: Recorded by code/alignment_fate/build_locus_data.py; the alternative isoform is the one carrying the most genome-only unique reads on non-selected sequence.

columns: metric=input_fragments rows for path in (ribo_genome, rnaseq_genome)
calculation: Sum of ribo input_fragments (8,847,967) + rnaseq input_fragments (5,339,716); identical across all 3 repeats.

columns: metric=input_fragments rows for path in (ribo_genome, rnaseq_genome)
calculation: Sum of ribo input_fragments (40,383,892) + rnaseq input_fragments (22,152,537); identical across all 3 repeats.

quantity: 50 (one_library) / 125 (three_libraries)
value: one_library 50/50/50; three_libraries 125/125/125; zero cached, zero retries, all exit 0

quantity: all exited successfully
calculation: Wrapper exit status per run.

quantity: median additional mapped RPF read IDs per library, genome minus transcriptome
calculation: Per sample delta = (n_genome_unique + n_genome_multi) - (n_txome_unique + n_txome_multi), in millions; median and quartiles (numpy percentile 25/75, linear interpolation) over the 24 cell lines. Exact: median 0.7232, IQR 0.4745-0.9924.

quantity: median % of the read-ID union: shared, genome-unique
calculation: 100 * (n_gU_tU + n_gU_tM) / n_universe per sample (the fig05_common.load_taxonomy both_genome_unique segment); median over the 24 cell lines. Exact: 75.3781.

quantity: median % of the read-ID union: shared, genome-multimapping
calculation: 100 * (n_gM_tU + n_gM_tM) / n_universe per sample; median over the 24 cell lines. Exact: 9.2759.

quantity: median % of the read-ID union: genome-only, genome-unique
calculation: 100 * n_gU_tA / n_universe per sample; median over the 24 cell lines. Exact: 9.2179.

quantity: median % of the read-ID union: genome-only, genome-multimapping
calculation: 100 * n_gM_tA / n_universe per sample; median over the 24 cell lines. Exact: 4.4749.

quantity: median % of the read-ID union: transcriptome-only
calculation: 100 * (n_gA_tU + n_gA_tM) / n_universe per sample; median over the 24 cell lines. The five segment percentages (C36-C40) sum to 100 per sample. Exact: 0.9665.

quantity: median % of shared genome-multimapping reads with a tied protein-coding / processed-pseudogene placement
calculation: Per sample cross_tie_pct = pct_cross_pp_pc + pct_cross_pc_pp (both tie directions; denominator n_reads = shared genome-multimapper read IDs, = taxonomy n_gM_tU + n_gM_tM); median and quartiles over the 24 cell lines. Exact: median 52.4154, IQR 49.5346-54.3424.

quantity: median % of genome-only unique reads on exons of nonselected isoforms
calculation: 100 * n_nonselected_isoform_exon / n_gUtA per sample (denominator = all genome-unique reads absent from every transcriptome primary at any MAPQ); median and quartiles over the 24 cell lines. Exact: median 38.0198, IQR 33.1989-40.7155.
